$comment: Round 1 (docs/round-1-contract.md §6): the ACCESSIBILITY contract every renderer keeps. `roles` = the MACHINE-READABLE role vocabulary (ARIA names, plus `text` = static text and `hidden` = out of the accessibility tree; SwiftUI traits / Compose semantics / AccessKit roles map from them), used by every `role` here and by the expanded tree's `accessibility.role`. `components` = per component its `role` (one of `roles`: the role of the component's main accessible object), `notes` (prose: composite parts, states, which strings name it) and the KEYBOARD expectations, one line per key group (arrows flip in RTL; a roving tab stop = one Tab stop for the group, arrows move inside it). Every component is listed (round1.test.ts gates it). `commands` = what a HOST may ask of a surface at runtime. `rules` = what holds for every component. Round 2 (docs/round-2-contract.md): Resizable, `scrollToIndex`, sections, the per-node direction rule. Append-only; docs/components.generated.json carries each component's entry.
rules: Every interactive node is reachable by Tab in reading order (tree order; a node's resolved `direction` flips its rows) and shows a focus ring only for keyboard focus (`:focus-visible`, recipe state `focus`).
A field's label, description and every error are linked to it (aria-labelledby / aria-describedby, contentDescription, accessibilityLabel/Hint); an error has the id `<node id>.error`.
`visible: false` removes the node from the accessibility tree; `visibility: hidden` hides it too; `display: none` likewise.
Icon-only buttons and standalone Icons take their `label` (or `accessibility.label`) as the accessible name; decorative icons are hidden.
`accessibility.label`/`description` on any node override the computed name/description.
Animations honour reduced motion: with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` transitions run at 0 ms, the Spinner/Skeleton shimmer stops and every style `animation` shows its rest keyframe.
Text and accessible names follow the NODE's direction (an inner `direction` box included): reading order, `textAlign` start/end and the bidi paragraph direction.

focus.description: Moves keyboard focus to the node with this id (the first focusable descendant of a non-focusable node); ignored when it is not rendered.

announce.description: Speaks the text through the platform's live region (`polite` waits, `assertive` interrupts) without showing anything.

scrollIntoView.description: Scrolls the nearest scrolling ancestor (List, ScrollArea, the surface) so the node is visible.

scrollToIndex.description: Scrolls the List or Table `id` so its item (data index, before any local sort) is in view: `align` start | center | end | nearest (default), the pinned section header subtracted; a windowed list renders it first (src/list.ts scrollOffsetForIndex).

Box.notes: group (button when pressable). A pressable Box is a button.
keys: Enter, Space: press (pressable only)
Arrow keys, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End scroll while focused

Section.notes: group; the header a heading (level 3) with the caption and count in its name, or a button with aria-expanded when collapsible; the rows a list (a tree when `tree`) of listitems
keys: Enter, Space: fold when collapsible

Group.notes: group labelled by its title, described by its footer

Label.notes: label of the control named by `for`
keys: Pressing it focuses that control

Alert.notes: alert for warning/error, status otherwise. alert for warning/error, status otherwise ($a11y).

keys: Enter, Space on the action

Meter.notes: meter (value of max, labelled by its label)

Sparkline.notes: img with a generated summary (first, last, min, max). The Chart painter names it with `sparklineSummary` (first, last, min, max).

List.notes: list; each item a listitem with its position in the WHOLE list (aria-setsize/posinset, also when windowed); a section header is a heading (level 3) and stays first in reading order while pinned
keys: Tab moves through the rows' controls; the list itself is one scroll region

Resizable.notes: group; each handle a focusable separator (aria-orientation = the line's, valuenow = the size of the panel before it, valuemin/max = its limits, controls = that panel), named `$string.resize`
keys: Arrow keys on a handle: move it on screen by 10 points (Left/Right horizontal, Up/Down vertical; rtl: ArrowRight shrinks the first panel)
Home / End: the panel before the handle to its min / max
Enter: collapse or reopen a collapsible panel

Text.notes: text (a live region when `live` is not off)

Markdown.notes: document fragment (headings, lists, links, tables keep their roles)
keys: Tab moves through the links
Tab reaches the copy button; Enter, Space: copy and announce `copied`

Image.notes: img (alt = name; decorative when alt is empty)

keys: Space: play/pause; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight: seek 5 s
Space: play/pause; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight: seek 5 s

Carousel.notes: region, roledescription carousel; each page a group `page i of n`
keys: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight: previous/next page while focus is inside
Home/End: first/last page
Roving tab stop on the tabs
ArrowLeft/ArrowRight: previous/next tab, activating it (wraps)
Home/End: first/last tab
Tab: into the active panel

Segmented.notes: radiogroup (single) or toolbar of toggle buttons (multiple); `bar` = navigation of buttons, the selected one aria-current=page
keys: Roving tab stop
ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (ArrowUp/ArrowDown): move focus (wraps)
Home/End: first/last
Space, Enter: toggle the focused item

Accordion.notes: headers = buttons with aria-expanded controlling regions
keys: Enter, Space: toggle the focused section
ArrowDown/ArrowUp: next/previous header
Home/End: first/last header
Opening moves focus to the first focusable child (else the dialog)
Tab cycles inside the dialog (focus trap)
Escape: close when dismissible
Closing returns focus to the trigger
As Dialog; a swipe toward the edge closes when dragToDismiss
Enter, Space on the trigger: open
Escape: close and return focus to the trigger
openOn hover also opens on trigger focus
Shows on hover AND keyboard focus of the anchor (after the platform delay); Escape hides

Menu.notes: menu / menuitem / menuitemcheckbox / group / separator; `openOn: contextmenu` opens at the pointer
keys: Enter, Space, ArrowDown on the trigger: open on the first item; ArrowUp: open on the last
Shift+F10 or the Menu key on the focused child (contextmenu): open at the child
ArrowDown/ArrowUp: next/previous item (wraps, skips disabled)
Home/End: first/last item
Enter, Space: run the item (a checkbox item toggles and stays open)
ArrowRight on a submenu: open it; ArrowLeft or Escape inside: close it
Escape: close and return focus to the trigger
Typing a letter: the next item starting with it
Never takes focus on appear; Tab reaches its action and close
Escape on a focused toast: dismiss
Hover or focus pauses the duration timer

Table.notes: table (grid when selectable): columnheader with aria-sort, row with aria-selected
keys: Enter, Space on a sortable header: cycle the sort (asc, desc)
Space on a row checkbox: toggle the row; on the header checkbox: select all
Enter on a focused row: rowPress
Tab moves through headers, checkboxes and cell controls

Chart.notes: img with a generated summary (kind, series, ranges); a data table fallback for screen readers. The painter names it with `chartSummary` (series, min, max) and offers a data table fallback.
keys: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight while focused: move the tooltip between categories
Enter, Space: press
A `submit` button submits the enclosing Form
Enter: open / press
Enter, Space: toggle
Enter in a single-line field: submit
A failed submit focuses the first invalid field and announces `invalidFields`
Enter: submit (fires `submit`, submits the Form)
Enter: newline
ArrowUp/ArrowDown: ± step (Shift: ×10)
PageUp/PageDown: ± 10 steps
Home/End: min/max
Enter or blur: commit and clamp
Space: toggle
Roving tab stop on the checked option
ArrowDown/ArrowRight: next option, selecting it (wraps)
ArrowUp/ArrowLeft: previous option

Switch.notes: switch; the label (and description) first, the switch at the end; the whole row toggles
keys: Space, Enter: toggle
ArrowRight/ArrowUp: + step; ArrowLeft/ArrowDown: - step
PageUp/PageDown: ± 10 steps
Home/End: min/max
Enter, Space, ArrowDown: open on the selected option
ArrowDown/ArrowUp: move the active option; Home/End: first/last
Enter: choose (multiple: toggle and stay open)
Escape: close without change
Typing: jump to the next matching option; with `searchable`, typing filters, focus stays in the search field and arrows move the active option (aria-activedescendant)

ChipInput.notes: textbox with a list of removable chips
keys: Enter or comma: add the typed entry
Backspace in an empty field: focus the last chip, again: remove it
ArrowLeft/ArrowRight: move between chips; Delete, Backspace: remove the focused chip
ArrowDown: open the suggestions (as Select)

DatePicker.notes: combobox opening a dialog with a grid of days
keys: Enter, Space, ArrowDown: open on the selected (else today's) day
Arrow keys: ± 1 day / ± 1 week
PageUp/PageDown: previous/next month (Shift: year)
Home/End: start/end of the week (locale week start)
Enter, Space: choose; Escape: close

DateRangePicker.notes: as DatePicker; the second choice ends the range
keys: As DatePicker; the first Enter sets the start, the second the end
As Select; typing `HH:mm` into the field commits on Enter or blur

FileUpload.notes: button (the drop zone) + a list of files with remove buttons
keys: Enter, Space on the drop zone: open the file picker
Tab reaches each file's remove button
Enter: submit; Shift+Enter: newline
Escape while busy: stop

Collapsible.notes: trigger = button with aria-expanded. The trigger is a button with aria-expanded = open ($a11y).
keys: Enter, Space: toggle

Pagination.notes: navigation of two buttons and a status. Labelled `pagination`; previous/next buttons and a status labelled `pageOf` ($a11y).
keys: Enter, Space on previous/next

Breadcrumb.notes: navigation (breadcrumb); the last item aria-current=page. Labelled `breadcrumb`; the last item aria-current=page ($a11y).
keys: Tab through the links; Enter: select

Stepper.notes: list; the current step aria-current=step. Each step a listitem labelled `stepDone`/`stepCurrent`/`stepUpcoming`; the current one aria-current=step ($a11y).

Rating.notes: A group of star buttons: each labelled `ratingStar` ("3 of 5"), the chosen one aria-pressed; read-only stars leave the tree and the group is an img labelled `ratingValue` ($a11y).
keys: Tab through the stars; Enter, Space: rate

AlertDialog.notes: alertdialog. The cancel button takes focus on open (`autoFocus`, $a11y).
keys: Opening focuses the cancel button
Escape: cancel; clicks outside are ignored

Sidebar.notes: navigation landmark (the sidebar slot) beside main. Layout only; its `sidebar` part is a navigation landmark, its `main` part the main landmark ($a11y).

AppBar.notes: banner (heading level 1 = the title). The title is heading level 1; the back button is labelled `back` ($a11y).
keys: Enter, Space on back

Row.notes: button (aria-selected when selected) when pressable, a group of its texts otherwise ($a11y); the guides are decorative
keys: Enter, Space: press (pressable only)

Chip.notes: button with aria-pressed (= selected) when pressable, text otherwise ($a11y); remove = button labelled `remove`
keys: Enter, Space: press; Delete, Backspace: remove when removable
